text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With her natural charms, Mayano Top
Gun has
become quite popular since she
started
streaming.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
However, it seems she's stopped
streaming for
some reason. We're
spending the whole day
together, so...

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Um... Nah, it got boring! Going out with
you is
much more fun!
choice_data_list: ……動画の配信、もうしないのか？
……動画の配信、もうしないの？

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
It was nice getting so much praise, but I
think I've
had enough!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: I-it's fine! Let's change the subject!
choice_data_list: あんなに楽しそうにしてたのに

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
There's a new issue of my favorite
magazine, so
I'm gonna go buy a copy!
See ya!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Without really saying anything, Mayano
Top Gun
runs off at full speed.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I decide to go through her archived
footage to
see if I can figure out what's
going on.
choice_data_list: でも、やっぱり気になる……

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Now that I've appeared in a few of her
streams,
there's a noticeable jealousy
toward me showing
through in the
comments.
choice_data_list: 俺への批判コメントが増えてるな……
私への批判コメントが増えてる……

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I wonder if these comments are the
reason why
Mayano Top Gun stopped
streaming.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
There are so many places she could have
run off
to, so I check them one by one.
choice_data_list: マヤノと話さないと……

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Trainer?!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
You've been looking for me all this
time?
choice_data_list: やっと見つけた……！

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
I-I don't want to talk about it. I already
told you
why I quit...
choice_data_list: 配信をやめた本当の理由を知ったから

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
I-I don't want to talk about it. I already
told you
why I quit...
choice_data_list: 俺を気遣ってくれてありがとう
私を気遣ってくれてありがとう
批判コメントなら全然気にしてないよ
配信をやめるのはもったいない
配信をやめるのはもったいないよ

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Once I tell her that I saw the negative
comments
and how grateful I am for her
consideration...
choice_data_list: 俺を気遣ってくれてありがとう
私を気遣ってくれてありがとう
批判コメントなら全然気にしてないよ
配信をやめるのはもったいない
配信をやめるのはもったいないよ

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Th-that's not it! I just got bored, I swear!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
I decided to stop for a while and
realized that I
shine the brightest when
I'm racing!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
I wanna keep running and working hard
with you
by my side.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
I wanna entrance people like never
before!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: S-stop! Quit making that sad face!
choice_data_list: マヤノ……

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
I'll always be happy as long as you're
with me,
Trainer—no matter what I'm
doing!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I nod silently at her words.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Even if she's lying, I'm sure it's for a
good reason,
and I shouldn't forcefully
try to expose her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Instead, as her trainer, it's my job to
help her
achieve her dreams and make
her shine.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Huh?!
choice_data_list: 絶対に幸せにするからな！
絶対に幸せにするから！

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: T-T-Trainer! What did you just—

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Oh... So that's what you meant.
choice_data_list: 君を誰より輝くウマ娘にしてみせる！
貴方を誰より輝くウマ娘にしてみせる！

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Okay, I'll make a promise too!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
I promise that I'll become a dazzling lady
who
never loses! I'll be as twinkly as the
stars!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: As long as I'm with you. ☆

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I explain to her that I want her to keep
streaming
just like she has been up until
now...

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: But why?!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
You should be upset! It should hurt!
You're always
working so hard...

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
You help me with filming and training,
and you're
always supporting me...

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
But those comments are my fault...
They're my
fault, so why?!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
You're being silly, Trainer! Why aren't
you mad at
me?!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Sniffle...

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Sob... This is what I mean...
choice_data_list: なんかごめん
なんかごめんね

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
I like how you're super nice to me, but
you're not
allowed to be this nice to
anybody else—only me!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
You can be as mad as you want at
comments
saying that you're
unnecessary or some kinda
bother!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Trainer...
choice_data_list: 邪魔かどうかはレースで判断してもらおう

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Fine! Guess I have no choice!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: That'll put the haters to shame!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The night sky above is full of shining
stars, as if to
represent the future.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She shouldn't quit streaming just
because of some
negative comments
directed toward me.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I ask if she has had fun with her audience
up until
now.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Of course I have, but they said such
terrible
things about you...

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: ...Okay. I'll give it one more shot.
choice_data_list: 今の気持ちを伝えれば理解してもらえるよ

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Um... Long time no see, huh? This is
Channel
Maya.

text_block_list.name: Comments
text_block_list.text:
Viewer A: Maya? Is it really you?! Viewer
B: I've
missed you so much! Viewer C:
She seems kinda
down.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, sorry. I've got something I wanna
talk to
you guys about today...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Saying this, Mayano Top Gun casts her
eyes
toward the ground, unsure of how
to broach the
subject.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
...Streaming has been really fun, and I'm
really
grateful that you guys have been
watching me.
choice_data_list: （マヤノ、頑張れ……！）

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
But all the negative comments toward
my trainer
make me upset.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
We're both working really hard so I can
win my
races...

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
I'm super glad to have your support, but
I don't
wanna be sad, y'know?

text_block_list.name: Comments
text_block_list.text:
Viewer D: We love you! Viewer E: Sorry,
Maya.
Viewer F: Guess we went too far,
huh...

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Thank you, everyone. But I still think I'm
gonna
take a break from streaming for a
bit.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
During my little hiatus, I realized
something—I'm
at my twinkliest when I'm
racing.
choice_data_list: えっ！？

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna miss you guys, but... I wanna
show you
the best, most amazing version
of myself!

text_block_list.name: Comments
text_block_list.text:
Viewer G: Are you serious? Viewer H:
This sucks...

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Guys...

text_block_list.name: Comments
text_block_list.text:
Viewer I: I'll support you, Maya! Viewer
J: Me
too! Viewer K: I'll come watch
your next race!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Thanks! You guys can always come to my
races!
I'll be waiting for you on the turf!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
At the next scrimmage, I notice an
unusually large
crowd of fans cheering
Maya on.
